title: Nvidia CEO Faces Investigation Amid Security Concerns
subtitle: Jensen Huang admits to an affair with a woman linked to Chinese intelligence, sparking questions about national security and company leadership.

summary.en: Nvidia has launched an investigation into its CEO, Jensen Huang, following reports that he had an affair with a woman suspected of spying for China. The company's stock price fell significantly after the news became public. Huang has apologized to his employees and family, promising to cooperate with the investigation. Meanwhile, US lawmakers are demanding answers regarding potential security risks to the company's technology. The situation has created uncertainty for one of the world's most valuable technology firms.
summary.zh: 輝達已針對執行長黃仁勳展開調查，起因是有報導指出他與一名涉嫌為中國從事間諜活動的女子有婚外情。消息公開後，該公司股價大幅下跌。黃仁勳已向員工與家人道歉，並承諾配合調查。與此同時，美國國會議員要求針對該公司技術面臨的潛在安全風險做出說明。此事件已為這家全球最有價值的科技公司之一帶來了不確定性。

paragraphs.en: Nvidia, a world-leading computer chip company, is facing a difficult period after its CEO, Jensen Huang, admitted to having an affair. The company’s board of directors has started an independent investigation into reports that Mr. Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort. This news caused Nvidia’s stock price to drop by 5 percent on Monday, as investors worried about the future of the company, which is central to the global artificial intelligence industry.
paragraphs.zh: 全球領先的電腦晶片公司輝達（Nvidia）正面臨一段艱難時期，其執行長黃仁勳（Jensen Huang）坦承自己有婚外情。該公司董事會已針對黃仁勳成為外國情報單位目標的報導，展開獨立調查。此消息導致輝達週一股價下跌百分之五，投資人對這家在全球人工智慧產業佔有核心地位的公司前景感到擔憂。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian Business, the investigation follows reports that Mr. Huang had a romantic relationship with Alice Huang. She is an executive at Megaspeed, a Singapore-based data company. The New York Times reported that US intelligence officials believe Alice Huang was gathering information for China. In an internal message to employees, Jensen Huang apologized for his actions. He stated that he was unfaithful to his wife and that he is fully committed to working with the board to earn back the trust of his team and the company.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《衛報商業版》（The Guardian Business）報導，這項調查源於黃仁勳與愛麗絲·黃（Alice Huang）有過一段浪漫關係的傳聞。愛麗絲·黃是總部位於新加坡的數據公司 Megaspeed 的高階主管。《紐約時報》（The New York Times）報導指出，美國情報官員認為愛麗絲·黃當時正在為中國蒐集情報。黃仁勳在給員工的內部訊息中為自己的行為致歉。他表示自己對妻子不忠，並承諾會全力配合董事會，以挽回團隊與公司的信任。

paragraphs.en: This situation has raised serious questions about US national security. Ars Technica reports that American officials wrote a memo earlier this year stating that the Nvidia boss had been involved with a woman recruited to spy for China’s Ministry of State Security. Because Nvidia is a leader in artificial intelligence technology, lawmakers are concerned that sensitive information could have been shared. Members of the US House of Representatives have asked Mr. Huang to attend a private briefing next week to discuss the company’s security rules and his relationship with Alice Huang.
paragraphs.zh: 此情況引發了關於美國國家安全的嚴重質疑。科技媒體《Ars Technica》報導稱，美國官員今年稍早撰寫的一份備忘錄指出，這位輝達執行長曾與一名被中國國家安全部招募的間諜女子有所往來。由於輝達在人工智慧技術領域處於領先地位，國會議員擔心敏感資訊可能已經外洩。美國眾議院成員已要求黃仁勳下週出席一場閉門簡報會，討論公司的安全規範以及他與愛麗絲·黃的關係。

paragraphs.en: There are also questions regarding how the US government handled earlier investigations into Megaspeed. The New York Times reported that a US Commerce Department investigation into the company was stopped after Nvidia’s general counsel contacted officials. Some government sources told the newspaper that this interaction may have violated standard procedures and affected the fairness of the investigation. The case has since been moved to the US Justice Department, which is now conducting a criminal inquiry into Megaspeed.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，美國政府先前處理針對 Megaspeed 調查的方式也引發質疑。《紐約時報》報導，在輝達的總法律顧問聯繫官員後，美國商務部對該公司的調查便遭到中止。部分政府消息人士向該報透露，這種互動可能違反了標準程序，並影響了調查的公正性。此案目前已移交美國司法部，該部門正針對 Megaspeed 進行刑事調查。

paragraphs.en: Despite the seriousness of these claims, the reaction from the White House has been calm. According to The Guardian Business, President Donald Trump said he still considers Mr. Huang an honorable person. While the president acknowledged that he had not spoken to the CEO about the situation, he suggested that Mr. Huang should remain in his position. Mr. Trump noted that the CEO has done an incredible job leading the company.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管這些指控事態嚴重，白宮的反應卻相當冷靜。根據《衛報商業版》報導，總統川普（Donald Trump）表示他仍認為黃仁勳是一位值得尊敬的人。雖然總統承認他尚未就此事與該執行長談過，但他暗示黃仁勳應留任原職。川普指出，這位執行長在領導公司方面表現卓越。

paragraphs.en: Political leaders are now looking for ways to protect American technology. Democrat Hakeem Jeffries, who is expected to become the new Speaker of the House, stated that Congress needs more information about the incident. He suggested that new laws restricting chip sales to China should be included in the annual defense bill to ensure national security. The focus for many lawmakers is to understand if any secrets were passed to foreign adversaries during the affair.
paragraphs.zh: 政治領袖們正尋求保護美國技術的方法。預計將成為新任眾議院議長的民主黨人傑福瑞斯（Hakeem Jeffries）表示，國會需要更多關於此事件的資訊。他建議應將限制晶片銷往中國的新法規納入年度國防法案中，以確保國家安全。許多國會議員的焦點在於釐清在這段婚外情期間，是否有任何機密被傳遞給外國敵對勢力。

paragraphs.en: For now, the future of Nvidia remains uncertain. The company has become the first $5 trillion business in recent years, largely due to the AI boom. Mr. Huang has been the face of this growth, but this scandal has placed his leadership in doubt. As the board continues its independent review, the company must work to prove that its security protocols are strong enough to protect its technology from outside influence. Investors and government officials will be watching closely to see how the investigation develops in the coming weeks.
paragraphs.zh: 目前，輝達的未來仍充滿不確定性。受惠於人工智慧熱潮，該公司近年成為首家市值達到五兆美元的企業。黃仁勳一直是這波成長的代表人物，但這起醜聞已讓他的領導地位受到質疑。隨著董事會持續進行獨立審查，公司必須努力證明其安全協定足以保護技術免受外部影響。投資人和政府官員將密切關注未來幾週調查的進展。

Jensen Huang has admitted to the relationship and apologized for his actions, stating he will cooperate fully with the inquiry. quiz.question: What immediate action have members of the US House of Representatives taken regarding Jensen Huang?

options.A: They have officially removed him from his position as CEO.
options.B: They have requested his presence at a private briefing to discuss security and his relationship.
options.C: They have launched a criminal inquiry into his personal finances.
options.D: They have demanded that Nvidia stop all chip sales to China immediately.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段，美國眾議院成員已要求 Jensen Huang 下週參加一場私人簡報會，討論公司的安全規則以及他與 Alice Huang 的關係。選項 A 錯誤，因為目前僅是調查階段，並未撤職。選項 C 錯誤，刑事調查是由司法部針對 Megaspeed 進行，而非針對 Huang 的個人財務。選項 D 錯誤，雖有議員提議在國防法案中加入限制，但並非眾議院已對 Huang 下達的具體要求。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the US government's past handling of Megaspeed?

options.A: The government was fully aware of the spying activities but chose to ignore them.
options.B: The investigation was likely compromised by outside influence from Nvidia.
options.C: The government successfully prosecuted Megaspeed executives last year.
options.D: The Commerce Department and Justice Department have always worked in perfect coordination.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據第四段，商務部的調查在 Nvidia 的法律顧問聯繫官員後停止，且有消息指出此互動可能違反程序並影響公正性，暗示了調查過程受到干預。選項 A 無法由文中證實。選項 C 錯誤，文中提到調查因故停止，而非成功起訴。選項 D 錯誤，文中顯示兩個部門處理方式不同，且商務部的調查過程受到質疑，並非協調一致。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the word 'face' mean in the phrase 'Mr. Huang has been the face of this growth'?

options.A: The physical features of a person's head.
options.B: The front part of an object or building.
options.C: The most visible representative or symbol of something.
options.D: To confront or deal with a difficult situation.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。在此語境中，face 指的是「代表人物」或「象徵」，意指 Jensen Huang 是 Nvidia 成長過程中最具代表性的領導者。選項 A 是字面意義，不符語境。選項 B 是指物體的表面，不符。選項 D 是動詞用法（面對），但文中此處為名詞，且語意不符。

quiz.question: What is the primary focus of the article?

options.A: A detailed biography of Jensen Huang's career at Nvidia.
options.B: The technical challenges of producing artificial intelligence chips.
options.C: The potential national security risks and corporate consequences of a scandal involving Nvidia's CEO.
options.D: The history of US-China trade relations regarding computer technology.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。全文核心在於探討 Jensen Huang 的婚外情醜聞如何引發國安疑慮、導致股價波動，並促使政府與公司董事會展開調查。選項 A 錯誤，文章僅聚焦於醜聞事件而非個人傳記。選項 B 錯誤，技術細節非本文重點。選項 D 雖有提及美中關係，但僅是作為背景，並非文章的主旨。
